# loraspectra (v1.2.0)
> Zero-Dependency Rust Engine, CLI & 100% Client-Side Browser Inspector for `.safetensors` Header Inspection, Spectral SVD Auditing, Silent SFT Bug Diagnostics (`rsLoRA` alpha/sqrt(r), `PiSSA` residual `pissa_init` hazards, DoRA magnitude-vs-direction stagnation, dead `<tool_call>` rows; SARIF v2.1.0 `LS001-LS022`), Checkpoint Differential Drift (`loraspectra diff`), Multi-Adapter Pre-Merge Conflict Analysis (`loraspectra merge-check`), HuggingFace Model Card Generation (`loraspectra card`), Global Budget-Optimal & Eckart-Young Dynamic Rank Compression (`rank_pattern` + scale-preserving `alpha_pattern`), and Orthogonal Subspace Merging (`ortho-svd`) of `.safetensors` LoRA/rsLoRA/PiSSA/DoRA Adapters.

- Interactive Browser `.safetensors` Header, Spectral SVD & Multi-Adapter `merge-check` Inspector (100% local Web File API, 0 uploads): https://salyys1.github.io/loraspectra/
- Repository: https://github.com/SalyyS1/loraspectra
- Releases: https://github.com/SalyyS1/loraspectra/releases
- Author: SalyyS1 (https://github.com/SalyyS1)
- License: MIT
- Speedup: 1,050x to 2,680x faster than dense SVD via QR-Core factorization (`O(r^2 d + r^3)`), matching `f64` singular values within `1.08e-13`.
- Remote Hub Support: Pass `hf://<org>/<repo>`, `hf://<org>/<repo>/<file.safetensors>`, or `https://.../*.safetensors` directly to `info`, `audit`, `diff`, `card`, `compress`, `interference [--json]`, `merge-check [--json] [--sarif]`, or `merge` (auto-cached in `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/loraspectra-cache/`; respects `HF_TOKEN`).
- Supported Formats: HuggingFace PEFT (`.lora_A.weight`/`.lora_B.weight`, `.pissa_init.weight`, `lora_embedding_A`/`B`), Kohya/ComfyUI/FLUX (`.lora_down.weight`/`.lora_up.weight` + `.alpha`), Diffusers, OneTrainer, and DoRA magnitude vectors in `F32`, `F16`, `BF16`.
- Companion Project: [mcp-slim](https://github.com/SalyyS1/mcp-slim) - Zero-dependency MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 proxy for token compression, sliding-window token governance, and real-time streaming secret redaction.
